parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass with a thin protective layer. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and other visual content. It serves as the primary output interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed and does not move, though it may tilt slightly if the stand allows adjustment.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic. It supports the screen and provides stability on a flat surface.
parts.Functional_description: The base holds the display upright and ensures balance. It may include a hinge or joint for tilt adjustment.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself is stationary, but it may allow limited rotational or tilt movement of the screen depending on the design.
